notes: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the top spot
Its biggest model is now a free download

bg_facts: Gemini 4 Carbon took the top spot on a major AI ranking.
Mistral made its biggest model free to download.
An AI model answered a prompt from orbit.
AI keeps getting better and cheaper.

slides.title: Google takes *the top spot*
slides.body: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, one point above Claude Opus 5.5. Only some security teams can use it so far.

slides.title: A giant model, *free*
slides.body: Mistral made its biggest AI model, about a trillion parameters, free to download.

slides.title: AI answers *from space*
slides.body: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite ran an AI model in orbit for the first time, answering a prompt sent from a ground station near Svalbard, Norway, with a haiku about space.

slides.title: What it means *for you*
slides.body: Top models keep getting better and cheaper, and free ones keep closing the gap. The skill that matters now is knowing what to ask.
